name: Light southerly
story: The high slides east and a soft southerly sets in. A mackerel sky of altocumulus in the afternoon, catching the sunset pink. Easy flying; the evening is mild and the moon sails through the dappled cloud.
forecast: Fair, altocumulus from 14:00 at 3500 m. South 8 kt. Visibility 40 km. Broken altocumulus at night, clearing toward dawn.
